top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) names one principle, chemically induced proximity to an E3 ligase so that a small molecule removes a protein rather than inhibiting it, realised by designed PROTACs and by the cereblon mechanism of thalidomide-type glues. It is a new capability, reproduced across many laboratories and supported by ternary-complex structures, and it can be stated in one sentence. Handa's cereblon identification is a distinct mechanistic discovery that links the glue strand to the PROTAC strand. Reservations remain: no approved degrader, crowded credit (Ciulli, Sakamoto, Ito, Gray, Kim), and a citation that must be drafted carefully. P002 (Ciulli in place of Handa) is a coherent PROTAC-only alternative, but leaves out the best-established mechanism in the field. P003 (ionizable lipid nanoparticles) is mature but needs two sentences to explain, rests partly on empirical industrial optimisation, and overlaps with the 2023 Medicine prize. No award is ranked last because a defensible, mature candidate exists.
